Rejected tool-position replay plot too close to SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001; replaced every turn and goal with actual seasoning changes versus printed recipe quantities and personal taste notes.

Replaced gift-recipient preference plot to avoid consent/refusal development recurring in SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001 and same-batch amulet draft. Current plot is early arrival for a bread reservation, maintaining the reservation and separately buying one display item.

Thematic review found the paper/email unpaid invoice chain repeated tax notice SC-LOC-014-10-001 despite low lexical retrieval. Replaced every turn and goal with current passbook service versus optional new-product leaflet and no new application.

Compare a booked service by operator and departure with another operator queue, then hand over baggage only after service confirmation. Not a charger-to-envelope substitution.
Staged consumption across days leads to buying only today and postponing future purchase; prior per-weight price misconception leads to cheaper amount under a fixed budget.

Same survey topic but distinct causal development: completed medical payment versus optional response, one voluntary comment, no added clinical/identity data, separate retention of payment papers. Prior third-party pickup and optional personal addition, or restaurant event changing business meeting to a meal, do not include this timing and evidence chain.

Current service scope plus declining an optional product application, leaflet-only receipt, understanding fee/termination questions and no signature. Prior is joint family savings planning with competing trip and school spending goals, not a new-product/application boundary.
